card.title: Samsung Galaxy A03s CPU Swap Step by Step Guide

source.title: Samsung Galaxy A03s CPU Swap Step by Step Guide

claims.statement: For data recovery from a dead Galaxy A03s, the paired CPU (MediaTek MT6765V, holds keys) and UFS (encrypted data) must both be moved intact to a working donor board; damage to either loses the data permanently.

Process outline: low-melt solder on the shield, lift at ~400 °C; clear underfill with a #11 scalpel; lift chips with a thinned spatula at 380–400 °C (max 2–3 min of heat at a time, never bend the chip); prep donor pads; reball with MT6765V stencil using dried XG-50 183 °C paste at ~320 °C / low air; install at ~320 °C, adding 20 °C steps if it won't settle.
After a successful swap, charge should show 5 V/9 V at 1 A+; back up immediately (Smart Switch) as swaps can be unstable.

procedure: Remove shield; clear underfill; lift CPU and UFS without bending.
Prep donor board pads (remove all underfill, low-melt, wick flat).
Install CPU then UFS at low heat; test charge and boot; back up at once.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Damaging the CPU or UFS makes the data unrecoverable; specialist-only.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
